verdict.rationale: Background automations are a fair question for an AI research notebook, but the evidence shows no user-configurable automations, schedules, or autonomous background workflows. The closest item, delaying generations for later when out of AI limits, is a one-off deferred generation rather than a recurring, autonomously running automation. Auto-generated source summaries are an adjacent built-in behavior, not user-set automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
